com.esignal.jstandard.beans.quote.dbc

Class DbcMonthYearQuoteRequestFilter

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.esignal.jstandard.beans.quote.dbc.DbcMonthYearQuoteRequestFilter
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    QuoteRequestFilter<java.lang.String>

    public class DbcMonthYearQuoteRequestFilter
extends java.lang.Object
implements QuoteRequestFilter<java.lang.String>
    This Filter is very important for DBCAPI options chain requests. In most cases, the client should apply this filter while making a Chain request. Please talk to the support if you do not understand the usage of this Filter. Applicable To: Stock Options, Future Options
